title: Reawakened End
description: An end update for Minecraft finally! Created by Pjluna and ShadowB.
body:
Reawakened End aims to add some new items and enchantments, focusing on end game progresson and to help get rid of some of the boringness of just following the story line within minecraft.

# New Item

![Some of the new items 0.1.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d66efd08a5043a280850c2065636741e663f148e.png)

The items within this picture are...

## Ender Spire

A new weapon that fire a end crystal projectile out to damage your enemy's but doing damage to the weapon itself.

## Space Clock
An item more useful than the clock, with this item you can now slow down time.

_(You can edit the duration with /gamerule and how much it slows down time)_

This item is useful for getting out of a pinch or using the speed boost when you exit to run away.

_(Just note that this item has a long cooldown after use)_

with other things added to the end dimantion

### Whats Next?
Thats it for now in the 0.1.1.0 update, but there is more to come later on!
